Class GUIApp

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.GUI.GUIApp
public class GUIApp extends javafx.application.Application
JavaFX Application entry point for the GUI client. It opens the first window — the server-connection choice screen (SocketRmiChoice.fxml) — and hands the configured ConnectionFactory to its controller.

The factory is injected through the static setConnectionFactory(ConnectionFactory) before launch is called, because JavaFX instantiates the Application itself and does not allow passing constructor arguments.

    • setConnectionFactory

      public static void setConnectionFactory(ConnectionFactory factory)
      Sets the connection factory the GUI will use to open server connections. Must be called before the application is launched, since JavaFX creates the instance reflectively.
      Parameters:
      factory - the connection factory to inject

    • start

      public void start(javafx.stage.Stage primaryStage) throws Exception
      Loads the connection-choice screen, injects the ConnectionFactory into its controller, and shows the primary window. The window is resizable with a minimum size, and closing it terminates the JVM.
      Specified by:
